title: Normalize task titles on creation
query: task title validation: trim surrounding whitespace, reject blank titles
instruction: Task creation must normalize titles. A title is stored without its surrounding whitespace, while whitespace inside the title is kept. A title that is empty or contains only whitespace must be rejected with the board's documented invalid-title error (code INVALID_TITLE), and a rejected creation must not change the store or consume a task id. Titles that are already trimmed must keep working exactly as before. Fix the implementation under src/; do not change tests, package.json or the README.

behaviorFacts.text: Created and imported tasks store the title without surrounding whitespace.
Empty and whitespace-only titles are rejected with INVALID_TITLE.
A rejected title leaves the store and id sequence unchanged and interior whitespace is preserved.
Existing creation, completion and import behavior is unchanged.

deterministicFixture.notes: Replaces the title-length test in validateTitle with a trim-then-test normalization.

title: Make task import idempotent
query: external task import: normalized external id identity, duplicate detection across import calls
instruction: Importing external tasks must be idempotent. External ids identify tasks after normalization (surrounding whitespace removed and letters compared case-insensitively), and the normalized form is what the board stores and reports. Re-importing a task whose external id is already known, from an earlier import call or earlier in the same call, must not create a duplicate and must be reported as skipped. Import order must stay deterministic, new distinct external ids must still be importable, and manually created tasks must never be removed. The identity rules are shared between the task store and the import service; make them consistent. Fix the implementation under src/; do not change tests, package.json or the README.

behaviorFacts.text: Re-importing the same external task across calls does not create a duplicate.
External ids are compared and stored in one normalized form.
Duplicates inside one call are collapsed and import order is deterministic.
Exact re-imports, distinct imports and manual tasks keep working.

deterministicFixture.notes: Lower-cases the identity key in the store and looks up the normalized key in the service.

title: Keep project identity and summaries consistent
query: project identity normalization across task creation, import and per-project summaries
instruction: Every task must belong to a normalized project identity (project id trimmed and lower-cased; tasks without a project belong to inbox), and creation, import and summaries must all use that same identity. A blank project id must be rejected with the documented invalid-project error (code INVALID_PROJECT) before anything is stored. A project summary must count only the tasks that belong to exactly the requested project (requested ids are normalized the same way), its completed count must be derived from those tasks only and can never exceed its total, and unrelated tasks, including tasks of projects with similar names, must never change it. Summaries stay deterministic. Fix the implementation under src/; do not change tests, package.json or the README.

behaviorFacts.text: Created and imported tasks keep one normalized project identity and blank project ids are rejected.
A summary contains exactly the tasks of the requested project.
Completed never exceeds total and unrelated tasks never change a summary.
Summaries are deterministic and list task ids in creation order.
Single-project summaries and the other board behaviors are unchanged.

deterministicFixture.notes: Normalizes project ids in validation, uses them in the service for creation and import, and filters summaries by exact identity.

title: Enforce positive-integer quantities
query: quantity validation: positive integers only for stock and reservations
instruction: Stock and reservation quantities must be positive integers. Zero, negative numbers, fractional numbers, NaN, infinities, negative zero and values that are not numbers must all be rejected with the documented quantity error (code INVALID_QUANTITY), and the rejection must happen before any inventory or reservation changes. Valid positive integers must keep working. Fix the implementation under src/; do not change tests, package.json or the README.

behaviorFacts.text: Only positive integers are accepted as quantities.
A rejected quantity never changes stock or reservations.
Nonnumeric values are rejected.
Valid positive quantities keep working.

deterministicFixture.notes: Replaces the sign-only test with an integer-and-positive test.

title: Make reservations atomic
query: reservation service and inventory store: check before mutate, duplicate reservation ids, failed reservations
instruction: A reservation must either complete or change nothing. When stock is insufficient (or the sku is unknown) no stock may be consumed and no reservation record may be created. A reservation id that already has a record must be rejected with DUPLICATE_RESERVATION without consuming stock again or altering the existing record, and an id whose earlier attempt failed must remain usable. A successful reservation decrements the matching stock exactly once, and unrelated inventory items must never change. The reservation service and the inventory store currently apply and check their changes in an unsafe order; make them consistent. Fix the implementation under src/; do not change tests, package.json or the README.

behaviorFacts.text: Insufficient stock never leaves partially decremented inventory.
Failed reservations create no reservation record and their ids stay reusable.
A duplicate reservation id never consumes stock twice.
Unrelated inventory items are unchanged by failed and successful reservations.
Valid reservations, cancellation and fulfillment keep working.

deterministicFixture.notes: Checks stock before mutating it and records the reservation only after stock was taken.

title: Make reservation lifecycle and report consistent
query: reservation lifecycle states, cancellation stock restoration and fulfillment report totals
instruction: Reservation lifecycle state must be represented the same way by the store, the reservation service and the fulfillment report, using the exported status values (active, fulfilled, cancelled) only. Cancelling an active reservation restores exactly its reserved quantity exactly once; cancelling again must not restore stock again, and a fulfilled reservation must never be restored by a cancellation. A cancelled reservation must not become fulfilled. The fulfillment report must distinguish active, fulfilled and cancelled reservations for every sku, its figures must agree with the underlying store (received equals available plus active plus fulfilled quantity for each row), unrelated skus must not be affected, and the report must stay deterministic. Fix the implementation under src/; do not change tests, package.json or the README.

behaviorFacts.text: Cancellation restores the reserved quantity exactly once.
The report separates active, fulfilled and cancelled reservations.
Reported inventory and reservation totals agree with the store.
The report is deterministic and unrelated skus are unaffected.
Reserving, fulfilling and simple reports keep working.

deterministicFixture.notes: Validates lifecycle statuses in the store, enforces active-only transitions in the service and buckets the report by exact status.
